items.title: No external evidence was retrieved
items.whyItMatters: Two recorded searches were empty; the leads are unchecked.
items.opportunity: Present local rates without external comparison and check the leads before citing any.

items.title: Shortage-related incidents are not flagged
items.whyItMatters: Finding them needs free-text search and matching by date and product.
items.opportunity: Pre-specify search terms and a two-person agreement check on a sample.

items.title: No agreed definition of a shortage-related error
items.opportunity: Adopt a written definition before extraction.

items.title: Children exposed to a concentration change
items.whyItMatters: Paediatric dosing errors can be larger in relative terms.

errorsFound: Incident counts alone would understate errors; the intervention log is needed as a second source.
reevaluation: A local retrospective review with two sources and a written definition is feasible and useful even without external comparison.
summary: Four gaps: no external evidence, unflagged incidents, no definition, and paediatric exposure.
